mapper.select: SELECT phone_enc FROM customers WHERE id = #{customerId}

SELECT request_hash, (response_body->>'currentStamps')::int AS current_stamps, (response_body->>'totalStamps')::int AS total_stamps, (response_body->>'giftCardsIssued')::int AS gift_cards_issued, (response_body->>'giftCardsRevoked')::int AS gift_cards_revoked FROM idempotency_keys WHERE scope = #{scope} AND key = #{key}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO idempotency_keys (scope, key, request_hash, response_status, response_body, created_at, expires_at) VALUES (#{scope}, #{key}, #{requestHash}, 200, CAST(#{responseBody} AS jsonb), #{now}, #{expiresAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, stamps_required_snapshot AS stamps_required FROM rewards WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND status = 'AVAILABLE' ORDER BY earned_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE rewards SET status = 'REVOKED' WHERE id = #{rewardId}
UPDATE stamps SET reward_id = NULL WHERE reward_id = #{rewardId}

UPDATE stamps SET status = 'REVOKED', revoked_at = #{now}, revoked_by = #{staffId}, revoke_reason = #{reason} WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM stamps WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND status = 'CONFIRMED' AND reward_id IS NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{count})

UPDATE loyalty_accounts SET current_stamps = current_stamps - #{count}, total_stamps = GREATEST(total_stamps - #{count}, 0), updated_at = #{now}, version = version + 1 WHERE customer_id = #{customerId}
mapper.select: SELECT current_stamps FROM loyalty_accounts WHERE customer_id = #{customerId}
SELECT current_stamps, total_stamps FROM loyalty_accounts WHERE customer_id = #{customerId}
mapper.update: UPDATE customers SET status = #{status}, updated_at = #{now}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{customerId}
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM fraud_flags WHERE customer_id = #{customerId}
SELECT customer_id FROM fraud_flags WHERE id = #{flagId}
mapper.update: UPDATE fraud_flags SET resolved_at = #{now}, resolved_by = #{staffId}, resolution_note = #{note} WHERE id = #{flagId} AND resolved_at IS NULL
